product.name: Monoprice Select Series USB-C to DisplayPort Adapter
product.description: This Monoprice™ USB‑C® to DisplayPort® adapter is the ideal solution for connecting your MacBook®, Chromebook™, or other computer with USB‑C video output to a high resolution 4K monitor. USB‑C is a new high-speed data and video integrated interface, which can support 4K video at 60Hz framerate. This small, portable adapter is easy to pack in your laptop case, so you will always have it ready to use. Additionally, it is a true Plug and Play device, with no need for driver or software installs of any kind.4K ResolutionPortablePlug and Play4K Resolution: Enjoy stunningly realistic and lifelike video with the maximum 3840x2160p (4K) resolution with a full 60Hz framerate and support for more than 1 billion colors.Portable: This small and portable adapter is easy to pack in your laptop case, so you will always have it at hand, ready for use.Plug and Play: This adapter is true Plug and Play device, with no need for driver or software installations of any kind. Just plug the reversible USB‑C® connector into your computer's video output and connect to your DisplayPort® monitor using a DisplayPort 1.2 cable (not included).CompatibilityCompatible with the USB‑C® equipped laptops, including the Apple® MacBook® and Google Chromebook™Buy with ConfidenceMonoprice not only stands behind every product we sell with a 1 year replacement warranty, we offer a 30-day money back guarantee as well!
